title: Come and see, come and see
lyrics: Verse 1:
Come and s[C]ee, come and s[G]ee,
Come and s[Bb]ee the King of L[A]ove;
See the p[Dm]urple r[A]obe and cr[F]own [G]of th[Am]orns He w[Bb]ears[G].

I w[G#o]orsh[Am]ip, I w[G]orsh[A]ip, The L[Dm7]amb w[G]ho was sl[C]ain.
